question: How did each salesperson's annual total sales compare to their annual sales quota? Provide the difference between their total sales and the quota for each year, organized by salesperson and year.
sql:
WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) as salespersonid,
           CAST(date_trunc('year', CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS VARCHAR) as order_year,
           SUM(TRY_CAST(totaldue AS DOUBLE)) as annual_sales
    FROM salesorderheader
    WHERE salespersonid != '' AND salespersonid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER), CAST(date_trunc('year', CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS VARCHAR)
),
quota_agg AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER) as BusinessEntityID,
           CAST(date_trunc('year', CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS VARCHAR) as quota_year,
           SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) as annual_quota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER), CAST(date_trunc('year', CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS VARCHAR)
)
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(s.salespersonid, q.BusinessEntityID) AS VARCHAR) as salespersonid,
       CAST(SUBSTR(COALESCE(s.order_year, q.quota_year), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as order_year,
       s.annual_sales,
       q.annual_quota,
       COALESCE(s.annual_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.annual_quota, 0) as sales_quota_difference
FROM sales_agg s
FULL OUTER JOIN quota_agg q
    ON s.salespersonid = q.BusinessEntityID AND s.order_year = q.quota_year
ORDER BY salespersonid, order_year;
